# Frameworks

What each framework specifies, where it sits, and what its source license permits

Table 1

The framework corpus splits along two axes: workforce versus pedagogy, and jurisdiction, which now takes 8 values (CA, CZ, EU, global, SA, SG, UK, US). The combinations are uneven. The US carries 5 of the 14 frameworks, and the 6 pedagogy frameworks sit in only 4 jurisdictions (EU, global, UK, US). Together the frameworks span the practical comparison surface for most cybersecurity workforce and education research questions.

Counts on this table use the with-examples figure. Strict counts (numbered standards only) appear on each framework’s page and on the [density-spread query](../queries/density-spread.llms.md).
